name: PMETAL
recent: Press Metal 公布 2026 财年第三季业绩，净利大幅增长并宣布每股 2.5 仙的第三次中期股息。同期，EPF 在 10 月底至 11 月中连续多日申报持股变动。
notable: 公布 2026 财年第三季业绩，净利同比大幅增长。
宣布第三次中期单层股息每股 2.5 仙。
EPF 在 10 月底至 11 月中连续多日申报持股变动。
risks: EPF 连续多日申报持股变动，显示大股东持股出现调整。
earnings: 2026 财年第二季（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 4,687.95 million，环比增长 14.4%，同比增长 11.9%；净利为 MYR 800.996 million，环比增长 28.3%，同比增长 65.6%；净利率为 17.1%，高于上一期的 15.2%。

recent_en: Press Metal reported strong 3Q FY2026 earnings with a sharp rise in net profit and declared a third interim dividend of 2.5 sen per share. Meanwhile, EPF filed multiple consecutive substantial shareholder notices from late October to mid-November.
notable_en: Announced 3Q FY2026 results with a sharp year-on-year rise in net profit.
Declared a third interim single-tier dividend of 2.5 sen per share.
EPF filed consecutive substantial shareholder change notices from late October to mid-November.
risks_en: EPF's consecutive filings indicate changes in a substantial shareholder's stake.
earnings_en: For 2Q FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was MYR 4,687.95 million, up 14.4% QoQ and 11.9% YoY; net income was MYR 800.996 million, up 28.3% QoQ and 65.6% YoY; net margin was 17.1% versus 15.2% previously.
